dimensions.assessment: Affects local historic preservation officers, historical societies, and tourism offices in New Hampshire consulted during the study.
dimensions.evidence: consultation with State and local historic preservation officers, State and local historical societies, State and local tourism offices

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes an administrative study without establishing a heritage area or new federal land protections directly.
dimensions.evidence: authorize the Secretary of the Interior to conduct a study to assess the suitability and feasibility of designating the Canterbury Shaker Village National Heritage Area

dimensions.assessment: Involves minor administrative costs for conducting a feasibility study.
Limited statutory directive focused solely on evaluating a specific geographic study area in New Hampshire.
dimensions.evidence: study area means the geographic boundaries of the Canterbury Shaker Village National Historic Landmark located in Merrimack County, New Hampshire.

dimensions.assessment: One-time study authorization rather than a permanent operational program.
